scope: Local cross-extension hardening slice (PKG RC-29, RC-31, RC-32): every offline extension classifier (exposure register, builder, QR-3 comparison, QR-4 selection, multi-Pine member set) compares column collation; the exposure register, research freeze and builder classifiers require the owner of their marker or anchor table (an anchor that is not an ordinary table classifies OTHER); the exposure register and research freeze inspections use the shared runtime-role module; the research freeze tool refuses before any write unless run as the owner of quant_jobs. Tracked comments no longer point at ignored local design files. The QR-4 PostgreSQL fixtures read the qualification version from the pure module. No DDL or function body changed: a fresh install of every extension still classifies INSTALLED.
method: A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote the slice. An independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) and a second-opinion reviewer (Fable 5.1) reviewed round 1 and both found that the freeze tool now had to run as the owner of quant_jobs without saying so; root confirmed it. Two narrow rounds followed (pre-write owner refusal, relkind filter, an anchor that is not a table, exact-name tamper assertions). An independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, fifteen PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (quant-library-http 16, gap-branches 7, compare-context 1, g5-register 11, mp-member-set-store 14, mp-member-set 22, quant-research-freeze 22, quant-exposure-register 18, best-inputs-package 26, quant-comparison 19, quant-comparison-create 12, quant-selection 15, quant-selection-register 26, qr2-reader 27, runtime-grants 1; fail 0 and skipped 0 in each), the grant text test and the full unit suite (2120 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped), plus five single-edit mutations (all killed). Root ruled on every finding. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: All affected PostgreSQL files pass with 0 skipped (see method), including the research freeze restart readback.

mutations.round2: 1 of 3 killed; the relkind filter and the prefix assertion became tests.
mutations.round3: 5 of 5 killed in the sole-runner pass (anchor problem, relkind filter, exact-name assertion and two from other lanes).

limits: Operators must run the research freeze tool as the owner of quant_jobs; any other user, a superuser included, is refused with no change.
A runtime role with CREATE on schema public, or reaching a superuser or bypass-RLS role, now fails the exposure register and research freeze inspections.
No install was run on any environment.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted the hardening slice as local engineering evidence for the extension rows (F09-01, F10-02, F10-03, F11-01). Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
